honesty.current_rtl_status: RTL-STUB: src/d2d_holo_mesh.v pin-correct single SYNC strobe + registered TX/RX; full mesh router PLANNED.
honesty.note: These conformance cases define expected receiver behaviour. The current stub MAY only implement the IDLE, SPIKE_SUMMARY, GF_TAG, and SYNC behaviours; other kinds are SPEC-DRAFT.

fields.name: SYNC
fields.notes: High pulse on w_tx; marks frame boundary.

fields.name: EPOCH
fields.notes: Monotonic frame epoch (wraps); pairs with audit-ring epoch.

ordering.rule: Within a single TX face, frames are delivered in epoch order; epoch values are monotonic per face and wrap modulo 2^8.
ordering.cross_face: No cross-face ordering is guaranteed; receivers MUST tolerate interleaving between N/E/S/W RX streams.
ordering.multi_chip: Across multiple Eulers, ordering is established by the BLAKE3 RECEIPT_BEACON epoch (kind 0x3). A receiver MUST drop a frame whose (kind, epoch, payload) hashes to a receipt different from the trailing RECEIPT field.

test_cases.name: valid_header_idle
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: accept; advance epoch counter; no audit-ring write.

test_cases.name: valid_header_spike_summary
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: accept; latch spike_count + spike_vec; write SPIKE_SUMMARY row to audit ring.

test_cases.name: bad_receipt
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: drop frame; increment bad_receipt counter; on 3rd consecutive failure, emit RESTRAINT_HOLD upstream and write a BAD_RECEIPT row to audit ring.

test_cases.name: unsupported_opcode
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: ignore payload but advance epoch; write UNKNOWN_KIND row to audit ring; MUST NOT assert RESTRAINT_HOLD (kind 0xF is reserved and may carry future-version traffic).

test_cases.name: rx_timeout_and_retry
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: after 256 idle cycles with no SYNC, emit RESTRAINT_HOLD upstream and write RX_STUCK row to audit ring; resume from IDLE once SYNC re-asserts.

test_cases.name: multi_chip_ordering
test_cases.expected_receiver_action: establish a total order across two Eulers by RECEIPT_BEACON epoch; drop any SPIKE_SUMMARY whose trailing RECEIPT does not match BLAKE3(KIND,EPOCH,PAYLOAD).

conformance_levels.C0: Spec-only: TC-001, TC-002 acknowledged in docs; no RTL receiver tested.
conformance_levels.C1: Stub-receiver: TC-001, TC-002 exercised by sim against d2d_holo_mesh.v stub.
conformance_levels.C2: Full receiver: TC-001 through TC-005 exercised by sim against an implemented mesh router.
conformance_levels.C3: Multi-chip: TC-006 exercised by sim across at least two Euler instances or one Euler + one Gamma instance.
conformance_levels.C4: Silicon: any of the above re-run on returned die. NOT achievable in this branch.

prohibited_promotions: Do not change KIND assignments in kind_registry without bumping spec_id and adding a VCM row.
Do not relabel tier to MEASURED. No D2D claim in this repo is silicon-tier.
Do not introduce a test case whose expected action contradicts docs/D2D_PROTOCOL.md §5.2 bridge invariant.
